records.source: Might be a good day to sit back and jam on the guitar...#$e#Hey, you can relax too if you want.
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw para maupo, magpahinga, at tumugtog-tugtog sa gitara...#$e#Uy, puwede ka ring magpahinga kung gusto mo.

records.source: Do you think Sebastian and Abigail will ever hook up?#$e#Heh... now that I'm married I'm trying to get everyone else married too.
records.translation: Sa tingin mo ba ay magkakatuluyan sina Sebastian at Abigail?#$e#Heh... ngayong may asawa na ako, sinisikap ko ring maipakasal ang lahat.

records.source: Hey, I found one of these rolling around in the back of a drawer. [90 88 86 535]#$e#I thought you might be able to use it.
records.translation: Uy, nakita kong nakakalat ang isa sa mga ito sa likod ng isang drawer. [90 88 86 535]#$e#Naisip kong baka magamit mo ito.

records.source: Aw, man. These cloudy days are kind of a drag...$7
records.translation: Aww, naku. Medyo nakababagot ang mga maulap na araw na ito...$7

records.source: How'd you sleep? The sound of rain really makes me zonk.
records.translation: Kumusta ang tulog mo? Talagang nakapagpapatulog sa akin nang mahimbing ang tunog ng ulan.

records.source: *Sigh*... I'm never gonna land this trick...$s
records.translation: *Buntong-hininga*... Hindi ko talaga makukumpleto ang trick na ito...$s

records.source: Hey, how was your day? I just lay around and read comics most of the day... it was great.$h
records.translation: Uy, kumusta ang araw mo? Humiga lang ako at nagbasa ng komiks halos buong araw... ang saya.$h

records.source: It was a pretty low-key day for me... colas, frozen pizza, a few hours noodling around on the guitar. I feel relaxed.
records.translation: Medyo tahimik lang ang araw ko... mga cola, nakapirming pizza, at ilang oras na walang-direksiyong pagtugtog sa gitara. Nakapagpahinga ako.

records.source: Earlier, I listened to our live recording from that show we played. Remember that? Man, was that sloppy.#$b#It made me a little nervous that you were there, I didn't want to mess up and have you think I was a loser!$10
records.translation: Kanina, pinakinggan ko ang rekording natin nang tumugtog tayo nang live. Naaalala mo iyon? Naku, ang gulo natin.#$b#Medyo kinabahan ako dahil naroon ka, ayaw kong magkamali at isipin mong talunan ako!$10

records.source: I hope Vincent's not too lonely now that I'm gone... I kinda felt responsible for the little guy.$s#$e#But, life's all about change... right? Kids need to learn that, eventually... Or else adulthood will destroy them.$7
records.translation: Sana hindi masyadong nalulungkot si Vincent ngayong wala na ako... Parang responsibilidad ko ang batang iyon.$s#$e#Pero puro pagbabago ang buhay... tama? Kailangang matutuhan iyon ng mga bata kalaunan... Kung hindi, dudurugin sila ng buhay bilang adulto.$7

records.source: Hey, I tossed a couple frozen pizzas into the oven. Here's yours. [206]$h
records.translation: Uy, nagsalang ako ng dalawang nakapirming pizza sa hurno. Heto ang para sa iyo. [206]$h

records.source: Phew... I'll tell you one thing I don't miss about my old life... working at JojaMart.
records.translation: Hay... Sasabihin ko sa iyo ang isang bagay na hindi ko nami-miss sa dati kong buhay... ang pagtatrabaho sa JojaMart.

records.source: Hey, I made you some instant pancakes. Enjoy. [211]$h#$e#What? I never learned to cook... mom always did that.
records.translation: Uy, ipinaghanda kita ng instant na mga pancake. Kain na. [211]$h#$e#Ano? Hindi ako natutong magluto... si Nanay ang laging gumagawa niyan.

records.source: Hey. I know I joke around a lot, but I want you to know that I seriously love you...$l
records.translation: Uy. Alam kong madalas akong magbiro, pero gusto kong malaman mong seryoso kitang minamahal...$l

records.source: Do you have big plans for the day?#$e#Oh, not me... I usually decide what to do a few moments beforehand...
records.translation: May malalaki ka bang plano para sa araw na ito?#$e#Ah, ako wala... Karaniwan ay nagpapasiya lang ako ilang sandali bago ko gawin ang isang bagay...

records.source: Um... Maybe I'll help out on the farm some other day. I feel lazy today.$s#$e#You're not mad?
records.translation: Um... Baka sa ibang araw na lang ako tumulong sa bukid. Tinatamad ako ngayon.$s#$e#Hindi ka galit?

records.source: Hey, you look tired. Let me help you relax tonight, okay? Maybe I'll give you a massage later.
records.translation: Uy, mukhang pagod ka. Tulungan kitang magpahinga ngayong gabi, ha? Baka imasahe kita mamaya.

records.source: My day? Oh... I can hardly remember. I didn't really do anything of note. Just relaxed and had a good time.
records.translation: Ang araw ko? Ah... Halos hindi ko maalala. Wala naman talaga akong ginawang mahalaga. Nagpahinga lang at nagsaya.

records.source: Hey, sorry I didn't make the bed. You know I'm sloppy... that's why you like me, right?$h
records.translation: Uy, pasensiya na at hindi ko inayos ang kama. Alam mong burara ako... kaya mo ako nagustuhan, hindi ba?$h

records.source: The only thing I miss about living at home is Mom's fish casserole
records.translation: Ang tanging nami-miss ko sa pagtira sa bahay ay ang kaserol na isda ni Nanay

records.source: Ready to hit the hay? I actually made the bed for once...
records.translation: Handa ka nang matulog? Sa wakas ay inayos ko rin ang kama kahit minsan...

records.source: Maybe I should get some off-road wheels for my skateboard. Mayor Lewis can't touch me out here.$h
records.translation: Baka dapat akong kumuha ng mga gulong na pangbakbakang daan para sa skateboard ko. Hindi ako masisita ni Mayor Lewis dito.$h

records.source: I always keep an eye on the wide blue sky... you never know when a UFO might go by.
records.translation: Lagi kong minamasdan ang malawak at bughaw na langit... hindi mo alam kung kailan may daraang UFO.

records.source: Hi, @! If I knew more about farm work I'd help you out more. Sorry!#$e#I'll try and help you with encouraging thoughts.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Kung mas marami akong alam tungkol sa trabaho sa bukid, mas matutulungan sana kita. Pasensiya na!#$e#Susubukan ko na lang palakasin ang loob mo.$h

records.source: Something in the air makes me feel positive... maybe it's the faint whiff of pizza from Gus' ovens.
records.translation: May kung ano sa hangin na nagpapasigla sa akin... baka iyon ang bahagyang amoy ng pizza mula sa mga pugon ni Gus.

records.source: Wow... you look great today, and the specks of mud just add some extra charm.$l
records.translation: Grabe... ang ganda ng hitsura mo ngayon, at lalo ka pang kaakit-akit dahil sa mga bahid ng putik.$l

records.source: I'll change %kid1's diaper... don't worry about it. You've got enough on your plate.
records.translation: Ako na ang magpapalit ng lampin ni %kid1... huwag kang mag-alala. Marami ka nang inaasikaso.

records.source: It's weird, but I really like being a father!$h
records.translation: Kakaiba, pero gustong-gusto ko talagang maging ama!$h

records.source: I think we should have another kid. Why stop now?
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, dapat magkaroon pa tayo ng isa pang anak. Bakit tayo titigil ngayon?

records.source: I woke up early, fed the kids and changed their diapers! We're all set. You can just focus on raking in that sweet money.$h#$e#I'm just kidding... I didn't marry you for the money.
records.translation: Maaga akong gumising, pinakain ang mga bata, at pinalitan ang mga lampin nila! Ayos na ang lahat. Magtuon ka na lang sa pagkamal ng tambak na pera.$h#$e#Nagbibiro lang ako... Hindi kita pinakasalan dahil sa pera.

records.source: We have to make sure and give %kid1 a lot of attention now that we have %kid2. We don't want any jealousy between them.
records.translation: Kailangan nating tiyaking mabigyan ng maraming pansin si %kid1 ngayong narito na si %kid2. Ayaw nating magselos sila sa isa’t isa.

records.source: It's fun to see the babies playing with each other. I think they're going to be very close.
records.translation: Masayang makita ang mga sanggol na naglalaro kasama ang isa’t isa. Sa tingin ko, magiging napakalapit nila sa isa’t isa.

records.source: I never thought I'd become such a family man, but I'm really satisfied with what we've built here. Life is going great.$h
records.translation: Hindi ko inakalang magiging ganito akong taong pampamilya, pero talagang nasisiyahan ako sa binuo natin dito. Napakaganda ng buhay.$h

records.source: Do you ever think of that night we snuck into my room? I do, often...$l
records.translation: Naiisip mo ba ang gabing palihim tayong pumasok sa kuwarto ko? Madalas ko iyong isipin...$l

records.source: You know, I think I had a feeling we'd be together from the very beginning. There's just something special between us.$l
records.translation: Alam mo, sa tingin ko ay naramdaman ko sa simula pa lang na magkakatuluyan tayo. May natatanging ugnayan talaga sa pagitan natin.$l

records.source: Wow, you look really handsome today! Did you do something with your hair?$l^Wow, you look stunning today. Did you do something new with your hair?$l
records.translation: Grabe, napakakisig mo ngayon! May ginawa ka ba sa buhok mo?$l^Grabe, napakaganda mo ngayon. May bago ka bang ginawa sa buhok mo?$l

records.source: Be careful out there! I know you go into the caves sometimes... you could be eaten alive in there!
records.translation: Mag-ingat ka roon! Alam kong pumapasok ka minsan sa mga yungib... baka kainin ka roon nang buhay!

records.source: Baby, I was just gonna write you a song on the guitar. But now you're here and I feel relaxed.#$e#I mainly feel like playing guitar when I'm lonely.
records.translation: Mahal, gagawa sana ako ng kanta para sa iyo gamit ang gitara. Pero narito ka na ngayon at panatag na ako.#$e#Karaniwan ay gusto kong tumugtog ng gitara kapag nalulungkot ako.

records.source: Baby, talk to me! I'm always interested to hear about your day.
records.translation: Mahal, kausapin mo ako! Lagi akong interesadong marinig ang tungkol sa araw mo.

records.source: I'm gonna visit the family today, okay? I'll be home in the evening.
records.translation: Dadalawin ko ang pamilya ngayon, ayos lang? Uuwi ako mamayang gabi.

records.source: Seeing family is nice, but it's also kind of depressing in a weird way. Like... our lives are totally separate now, and everything feels more formal than it used to.$7
records.translation: Masarap makita ang pamilya, pero nakalulungkot din iyon sa kakaibang paraan. Parang... ganap nang magkakahiwalay ang mga buhay namin, at mas pormal na ang lahat kaysa dati.$7

records.source: Ub... spring... my doze... allergies.$s
records.translation: Uh... tagsibol... ilong ko... mga allergy.$s

records.source: Are you excited for tomorrow's festival? It'll be cool to see Sebastian again.
records.translation: Nasasabik ka ba sa pista bukas? Masayang makita ulit si Sebastian.

records.source: Oh... tomorrow's the flower dance, isn't it? I thought I could get out of it now that we're married.#$e#Whatever. I guess it's funny in a weird way.
records.translation: Ah... Sayaw ng Bulaklak bukas, hindi ba? Akala ko ay makakaiwas na ako ngayong kasal na tayo.#$e#Bahala na. Nakakatawa rin iyon sa kakaibang paraan.

records.source: The pollen count is a little lower in summer, so my nose is really happy.$h
records.translation: Mas kaunti ang polen sa tag-init, kaya tuwang-tuwa ang ilong ko.$h

records.source: Have you thought about what you're going to put in the luau soup?#$e#It might be funny to put something nasty. You know, to play a prank on the governor!$h#$e#Sorry...
records.translation: Naisip mo na ba kung ano ang ilalagay mo sa sopas ng Luau?#$e#Baka nakakatawang maglagay ng isang nakakadiring bagay. Alam mo na, para biruin ang gobernador!$h#$e#Pasensiya na...

records.source: Summer's great, but I'm ready for the fall now.#$e#Should we watch the jellyfish tomorrow night? It's always kind of fun.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng tag-init, pero handa na ako para sa taglagas.#$e#Manonood ba tayo ng mga dikya bukas ng gabi? Lagi iyong medyo masaya.

records.source: It seems like the whole valley's changed overnight... I guess fall's finally here.
records.translation: Parang nagbago ang buong lambak sa magdamag... Mukhang dumating na nga ang taglagas.

records.source: Hey, tomorrow's the fair. I need to get my old slingshot wrist back in shape...
records.translation: Uy, perya bukas. Kailangan kong muling sanayin ang pulso ko sa paggamit ng tirador...

records.source: I wonder if Mom will let Vincent enter the haunted maze this year. Probably not...$h#$e#Poor kid. He's gonna have to grow up some day...
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung papayagan ni Nanay si Vincent na pumasok sa nakatatakot na labirinto ngayong taon. Malamang hindi...$h#$e#Kawawang bata. Kailangan din niyang lumaki balang-araw...

records.source: The cold air makes my hair gel freeze. It's not very pleasant.$s
records.translation: Nagyeyelo ang gel sa buhok ko dahil sa malamig na hangin. Hindi ito kaaya-aya.$s

records.source: Are we going to stop by the ice festival tomorrow? It might be fun to see everyone again...
records.translation: Dadaan ba tayo sa Pista ng Yelo bukas? Baka masayang makita ulit ang lahat...

records.source: We had a great year, @... it's kind of sad that it's over.#$e#We'll just have to make next year even better!$h
records.translation: Napakaganda ng taon natin, @... medyo malungkot na tapos na ito.#$e#Kailangan lang nating gawing mas maganda pa ang susunod na taon!$h
